entries.speaker: Transformation Tile
entries.en: By stepping on certain tiles in the Thieves Den, you[n]can [clr 2]change your character to whoever is drawn on the[n]tile[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Transformation Tile
entries.en: By stepping on the same tile, you will be able to[n]change into different outfits. Press [clr 2][f 1 10 63][clr 27] to return to[n]your normal self.
